load-guidelines.desc: Load the plan design guidelines and schema reference.
load-guidelines.choose_when: Session overview has been read and internalized.

scout.desc: Dispatch parallel scouts to explore the codebase.
scout.choose_when: Design guidelines and plan schema have been loaded.

clarify.choose_when: Task description has been captured and initial ambiguities identified.

synthesize.desc: Synthesize scout findings into a coherent codebase understanding.
synthesize.choose_when: Enough information has been gathered to proceed with decomposition.

clarify.choose_when: There are still critical unknowns that would block decomposition.

decompose.desc: Break the work into concrete, ordered subtasks.
decompose.choose_when: Codebase understanding has been synthesized and presented to the user.

task-intake.desc: Capture and clarify the task description.
task-intake.choose_when: Scout agents have returned their codebase findings.

agent-routing.desc: Assign agents and models to each subtask.
agent-routing.choose_when: Subtask breakdown has been drafted and presented to the user.

review-gate.desc: Present the complete plan for user approval.
review-gate.choose_when: Agent routing assignments have been completed for all subtasks.

finalize.desc: Write all session plan artifacts to disk.
finalize.choose_when: User has approved the plan as presented.

decompose.desc: Rework the subtask breakdown based on user feedback.
decompose.choose_when: User wants to add more subtasks or restructure the task list.

clarify.desc: Return to clarifying requirements before rebuilding the plan.
clarify.choose_when: User has identified gaps or changes in the original requirements.
